chunks: What the Shaykh—may Allah support him—informed me of by the preceding chain: from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad and Aḥmad, the two sons of al-Ḥasan, from their father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
“When the woman menstruates, then let her husband approach her however he wishes, so long as he avoids the place of blood.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman, here meaning the wife

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about intimacy with one's wife during menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning marital intimacy during menstruation. It indicates permissibility of intimacy with one's wife during her menses, with the restriction that the place of blood must be avoided.
